text:
alex: heads-up: after yesterday's v2 rollout we saw a bump in 'quota_exceeded' errors from a few tenants. spike aligns with clients setting `x-api-version: v2`. can someone sanity-check if token accounting changed?
morgan: saw this too in the dashboard — quota usage for the same request shape looks ~12-18% higher when routed to v2. tracing shows fewer prefix cache hits.
riley: hmm, v2's canonicalization step strips repeated whitespace which changes caching keys. that could cause miss rate to go up.
samira: is that intentional? i thought canonicalization was meant to improve cache effectiveness by normalizing inputs.
riley: intent yes, but we also changed the cache key salt to include a model-variant tag for safer rollouts. combined effect -> lower cache reuse for certain tenants.
ben: quick numbers: tenant A had cache hit 72% -> 49% after switch. tokens per request +11% avg. that pushes them over monthly quota thresholds.
alex: so behavior difference + telemetry delta = surprising billing/console UX. we should communicate and maybe add a console note.
morgan: agreed — console should surface a "versioned metering diff" preview before forcing rollout. users need to see expected token delta.
samira: +1 for preview. also we need a soft-fallback: if tenant hits quota, degrade to v1-compatible path rather than rejecting hard. rollback is messy.
riley: fallback is doable but we must be careful with semantics — v2 can produce structured outputs not compatible with v1. fallback should be limited to freeform/text routes only.
alex: action items: (1) telemetry: add a per-route `metering_delta_estimate` signal for v2 vs v1, (2) console: add an opt-in preview toggle when changing route default, (3) runtime: implement a permissive fallback for text-only endpoints.
ben: i'll draft the telemetry metric. quick suggestion for metric name: `ingested_tokens_delta_v2_vs_v1_p95`.
morgan: console mockups: we can show a 30/60/90 day projected overage graph with toggles for sample cohorts and show approximate $$ impact. i'll iterate.
samira: runtime fallback ops: we need a circuit-breaker that counts fallback hits and emits an event so customers can opt-in to automatic fallback. also rate-limit fallbacks to avoid thundering.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary telemetry agent (branch: metering-delta) -> staging at 1734567812.
alex: timeline: try to get telemetry + console preview in next sprint. runtime safe-fallback as follow-up but put a temporary console warning immediately.
ben: noted. i'll open a short PR with metric + sampling config.
riley: i'll add docs in /docs/compat for the cache key change and examples of request shapes that lose caching.
morgan: i'll upload the mock to figma and ping product for copy.
samira: perfect. thanks all. :thumbsup:
